title: Membership Tenure Bonus on Northgate+ Business Cash
content:
**Rule.** Under the Business earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the length of the Northgate+ Business membership adds percentage points to the Business earning percentage of the line the schedule settles, measured in whole calendar months from the membership's term start date to the order's fulfilled date:

- 24 or more whole calendar months: **0.5** points;
- 12 to fewer than 24 whole calendar months: **0.25** points;
- fewer than 12, or no term start date on the membership record: no points.

A whole calendar month is counted when the fulfilled date reaches the same day of the month as the term start date.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical term start date 2 April 2030)**

| Fulfilled date | Whole calendar months | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 1 April 2031 | 11 | none |
| 2 April 2031 | 12 | 0.25 |
| 1 April 2032 | 23 | 0.25 |
| 2 April 2032 | 24 | 0.5 |
